newsitem.title: USA: Security First ANZ in Internet banking pact.
newsitem.headline: Security First ANZ in Internet banking pact.

text.p: Security First Technologies, a unit of Security First Network Bank, on Monday said the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd will use Security First's Internet banking software for its own banking service.
Starting in mid-1997, ANZ will use Security First's Virtual Financial Manager software for its new PC Banking service, with Security First assisting with the integration and customization of VFM.
Terms of the deal were not announced.

Security First also said ANZ bought Hewlett-Packard Inc's VirtualVault security platform, which was originally developed by Security First. VirtualVault provides security for conducting secure transactions over the Internet.
VFM will allow ANZ customers to perform banking functions at any time via the Internet, using standard World Wide Web browsers, they said.
